From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
French Football Ligue 1 records
The following is a **list of records attained in French Football[Ligue 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ligue_1 "Ligue 1")** since the league foundation in 1932.
## Club statistics
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Club statistics")]
### Titles and points
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Titles and points")]
  * **Most titles** : 14, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC")
  * **Most consecutive titles** : 7, [Lyon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_Lyonnais "Olympique Lyonnais") (2002–08)
  * **Most points in a single season** : 
    * 38-match season: 96, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2015–16)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics#cite_note-2015-16_stats-1)
    * 34-match season: 84, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2024–25)


### Wins and unbeaten runs
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Wins and unbeaten runs")]
  * **Most wins in a single season** : 
    * 38-match season: 30, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2015–16) and [Monaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Monaco "AS Monaco") (2016–17)
    * 34-match season: 26, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2024-25)
  * **Most home victories in a single season** : 19, [Saint-Étienne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Saint-%C3%89tienne "AS Saint-Étienne") (1974–75)
  * **Most away victories in a single season** : 15, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2015–16)
  * **Most consecutive victories** : 16, [Monaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Monaco "AS Monaco") (between 25 February 2017 and 17 August 2017)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics#cite_note-2)
  * **Most consecutive victories in a single season** : 14, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2018–19)
  * **Most consecutive home victories** : 28, [Saint-Étienne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Saint-%C3%89tienne "AS Saint-Étienne") (between 13 March 1974 and 27 August 1975)
  * **Most consecutive away victories** : 9, [Marseille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_de_Marseille "Olympique de Marseille") (between 15 February 2009 and 8 August 2009)
  * **Biggest win:** [Sochaux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Sochaux-Montb%C3%A9liard "FC Sochaux-Montbéliard") 12–1 [Valenciennes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valenciennes_FC "Valenciennes FC") (1 July 1935)
  * **Biggest away win:** [Troyes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Troyes_AC "Troyes AC") 0–9 [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (13 March 2016)
  * **Longest unbeaten run** : 36 matches, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (between 15 March 2015 and 20 February 2016)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics#cite_note-2015-16_stats-1)
  * **Longest unbeaten run within a single season** : 32 matches, [Nantes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Nantes "FC Nantes") (1994–95)
  * **Longest home unbeaten run** : 92 matches, [Nantes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Nantes "FC Nantes") (between 15 May 1976 and 7 April 1981)
  * **Longest away unbeaten run** : 39 matches, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (between 11 February 2023 – 03 May 2025)

  * **Fewest losses in a single season** : 1, [Nantes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Nantes "FC Nantes") (1994–95)
  * **Fewest home losses in a single season** : 0 (58 times) 
    * [Angers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angers_SCO "Angers SCO") (1971–72)
    * [Auxerre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Auxerre "AJ Auxerre") (1984–85, 1988–89, 1991–92)
    * [Bastia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SC_Bastia "SC Bastia") (1972–73, 1976–77)
    * [Bordeaux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Girondins_de_Bordeaux "FC Girondins de Bordeaux") (1984–85, 1985–86, 1987–88, 1992–93, 2008–09)
    * [Cannes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Cannes "AS Cannes") (1989–90)
    * [Laval](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stade_Lavallois "Stade Lavallois") (1985–86)
    * [Lens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RC_Lens "RC Lens") (1976–77, 2001–02)
    * [Lillois](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_Lillois "Olympique Lillois") (1933–34)
    * [Lyon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_Lyonnais "Olympique Lyonnais") (1994–95, 2001–02)
    * [Marseille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_de_Marseille "Olympique de Marseille") (1937–38, 1947–48, 1970–71, 1988–89, 1998–99)
    * [Monaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Monaco_FC "AS Monaco FC") (1982–83, 1992–93, 1996–97, 1999–2000)
    * [Nancy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Nancy_Lorraine "AS Nancy Lorraine") (1977–78)
    * [Nantes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Nantes "FC Nantes") (1965–66, 1966–67, 1976–77, 1977–78, 1978–79, 1979–80, 1994–95)
    * [Nîmes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%AEmes_Olympique "Nîmes Olympique") (1952–53, 1958–59)
    * [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (1985–86, 1993–94, 2014–15, 2016–17, 2018–19, 2021–22)

    * [Saint-Étienne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Saint-%C3%89tienne "AS Saint-Étienne") (1973–74, 1974–75, 1975–76, 1976–77)
    * [Sète](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_S%C3%A8te "FC Sète") (1933–34, 1936–37)
    * [Sochaux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Sochaux-Montb%C3%A9liard "FC Sochaux-Montbéliard") (1936–37, 2002–03)
    * [Strasbourg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RC_Strasbourg_Alsace "RC Strasbourg Alsace") (1974–75, 1977–78, 1978–79)
    * [Toulouse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toulouse_FC "Toulouse FC") (1953–54, 1986–87)
    * [Valenciennes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valenciennes_FC "Valenciennes FC") (1964–65)
  * **Fewest away losses in a single season** : 0, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2023–24)


### Top flight appearances
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Top flight appearances")]
  * **Most seasons in top flight** : 77, [Marseille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_de_Marseille "Olympique de Marseille")
  * **Most consecutive seasons in top flight** : 53, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (1974–present)


### Goals
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Goals")]
  * **Highest-scoring season** : 
    * 38-match season: 1946–47 (134 goals; 3.51 average per match)
    * 34-match season: 1948–49 (113 goals; 3.71 average per match)
  * **Most goals scored by a team in a single season** : 
    * 38-match season: 118, [RC Paris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Racing_Club_de_France_Football "Racing Club de France Football") (1959–60)
    * 34-match season: 102, [Lille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lille_OSC "Lille OSC") (1948–49)
  * **Most goals in a single match** : 13 
    * [Sochaux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Sochaux-Montb%C3%A9liard "FC Sochaux-Montbéliard") 12–1 [Valenciennes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valenciennes_FC "Valenciennes FC") (1 July 1935)
    * [Marseille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_de_Marseille "Olympique de Marseille") 3–10 [Saint-Étienne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Saint-%C3%89tienne "AS Saint-Étienne") (16 September 1951)
    * [RC Paris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Racing_Club_de_France_Football "Racing Club de France Football") 11–2 [Metz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Metz "FC Metz") (19 November 1961)
  * **Fewest goals conceded by a team in a single season** : 19, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2015–16)
  * **Fewest home goals conceded by a team in a single season** : 4, [Saint-Étienne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AS_Saint-%C3%89tienne "AS Saint-Étienne") (2007–08)
  * **Fewest away goals conceded by a team in a single season** : 7, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2015–16)
  * **Best[goal difference](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goal_difference "Goal difference") in a single season**: 
    * 38-match season: +83, [Paris Saint-Germain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Saint-Germain_FC "Paris Saint-Germain FC") (2015–16)
    * 34-match season: +62, [Lille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lille_OSC "Lille OSC") (1948–49)


### Disciplinary
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Disciplinary")]
  * **Most yellow cards in a season** : 654 (2002–03)
  * **Most red cards in a season** : 131 (2002–03)
  * **Most red cards by a team in a single season** : 14, [Montpellier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Montpellier_HSC "Montpellier HSC") (2013–14)


### Manager
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: Manager")]
  * **Most matches managed** : 894, [Guy Roux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guy_Roux "Guy Roux") (890 for [Auxerre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Auxerre "AJ Auxerre") (1961–2000, 2001–2005) and 4 for [Lens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RC_Lens "RC Lens") (2007–2008))


### Attendance
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Attendance")]
  * **Highest overall attendance in a season** : 
    * 38-match season: 8,997,104 (2022–23)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Ligue_1_records_and_statistics#cite_note-3)
    * 34-match season: 8,519,028 (2024–25)
  * **Highest average attendance in a season** : 
    * 38-match season: 23,677 (2022–23)
    * 34-match season: 27,840 (2024–25)
  * **Highest overall attendance in a single matchday** : 307,775 (2018–19 matchday 1; 30,778 average per match)
  * **Highest attendance in a single match** : 78,056, [Lille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lille_OSC "Lille OSC") v. [Lyon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympique_Lyonnais "Olympique Lyonnais") at the [Stade de France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stade_de_France "Stade de France") (7 March 2009)
